events.title: 입스위치 타운 beat 애스턴 빌라 1–0 in a heavyweight clash in the FA Cup third round. 에버턴 defeat 아스널 2–0.
애스턴 빌라 move to the top of the First Division after beating 리버풀 2–0 at Villa Park .

January draws to a close with 입스위치 타운 back on top of the First Division, ahead of second placed 애스턴 빌라 on goal difference with a game in hand. 리버풀's 85-match unbeaten home run in all competitions since February 1978 is ended by a 2–1 home defeat to struggling 레스터 시티, and the Reds are now four points off the top. 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 complete the top five, while 맨체스터 유나이티드, with fifteen draws already this season, have fallen to ninth in the table. 크리스털 팰리스, 레스터 시티 and 노리치 시티 remain in the bottom three. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 continue to lead the race for promotion, with 노츠 카운티 and 첼시 completing the top three.
